name: person-hover-card
title: Person Hover Card
description: A person behind an avatar or a name: hover, focus or tap opens a compact card with a 32px avatar, the name and a muted email.

meta.whenToUse: Preview a person behind their avatar or name (a comment's author, an activity's actor, a participant). Stacks of people are MembersStack.
meta.whenNotToUse: A picker of people (SearchableSelect) or a full member list (DataList).
